title: ObservationBatchRequest
description: Payload a microservice POSTs to {mycelium}/api/things/{thingId}/observations to record many Observations across one entity's properties in a single batch. Shape derived from vos.ManagedMicroservice.Shared.MyceliumClientBase.RecordObservationsAsync and Mycelium's BatchObservationItem[].

property.description: Name of the property on the entity to observe.

value.description: The sampled value: any JSON scalar (string, number, boolean) or null.

observedAt.description: Source-supplied observed-time as an ISO-8601 string; optional.
